about: The everyday reads of a ball, for a remark on most balls (sim/ball-reads.js): the shot (timing, feet, a charge, an edge that got away), the bowling (beaten outside off, the bouncer, the yorker, the slower ball, a loose one), the players and the running. And the run-up reads of the over so far (sim/runup-reads.js), short so they're done before he lets go.

bunnings: MARVELLOUS. HE BARELY SEEMED TO HIT IT.

bunnings.text: THAT'S A DRIVE THEY'LL BE SHOWING AT LUNCH.

lorry: OH, WHAT A {shot}! TIMED TO PERFECTION!
PURE TIMING! THE FIELDER NEVER MOVED!
grog: HEAD OVER IT, FRONT FOOT TO THE PITCH. THAT'S HOW YOU DRIVE.

grog.text: FULL AND WIDE WITH TWO MEN OUT. YOU CAN'T BOWL THERE.

bunnings: PUT AWAY WITH SOME DISDAIN.
lorry: CRACKED! HE'S GONE BACK AND JUST FLAYED THAT!
grog: GIVE HIM WIDTH OR A SHORT ONE AND HE'LL PUNISH IT. THAT WAS BOTH.

bunnings: SWEPT, AND SWEPT WELL.
lorry: DOWN ON ONE KNEE AND SWEPT! LOVELY!
grog: HE READ THE LENGTH EARLY AND GOT DOWN. THE SPINNER HAS TO CHANGE IT.

bunnings: UP AND OVER. QUITE DELIBERATE.
lorry: OVER THE TOP! HE'S CLEARED THE INFIELD WITH ROOM TO SPARE!
grog: THE FIELD WAS UP AND HE'S HIT OVER IT. THAT'S THE CAPTAIN'S CALL NOW.

bunnings: A TOUCH OF THE WRISTS. VERY TIDY.
lorry: JUST CARESSED AWAY! LOVELY WRISTS!
grog: ON THE PADS, AND HE'S USED THE PACE. YOU CAN'T BOWL THERE TO HIM.

bunnings: IN A HURRY THERE. THE BALL WAS IN RATHER LESS OF ONE.
lorry: WAY TOO EARLY! HE'S FINISHED THE SHOT BEFORE IT ARRIVED!
grog: THROUGH THE SHOT TOO SOON. EITHER THE CHANGE OF PACE DID HIM, OR HE GUESSED.

bunnings: A FRACTION LATE. THE BALL GOT THERE FIRST.
lorry: LATE ON IT! THE PACE HAS HURRIED HIM!
grog: LATE ON THE SHOT. HE HAS TO GET THE FEET MOVING SOONER.

bunnings: THE FEET WENT ONE WAY, THE BALL THE OTHER.
lorry: WRONG FOOT! HE'S IN A TANGLE THERE!
grog: THE LENGTH SAID ONE THING, HIS FEET SAID ANOTHER. THAT'S WHERE EDGES COME FROM.

bunnings: STUCK ON THE CREASE. NEITHER FORWARD NOR BACK.
lorry: HIS FEET HAVEN'T MOVED! HE'S ROOTED TO THE SPOT!
grog: NO FOOTWORK AT ALL. AGAINST THIS ATTACK YOU HAVE TO COMMIT ONE WAY OR THE OTHER.

bunnings: A LONG WAY ACROSS. THE STUMPS ARE RATHER ON SHOW.
lorry: HE'S WALKED RIGHT ACROSS! THE BOWLER WILL HAVE SEEN THAT!
grog: TOO FAR OVER. AIM AT THE PADS AND YOU'VE GOT THE LBW IN PLAY.

bunnings: REACHING FOR THAT ONE. IT WAS NEVER REALLY HIS.
lorry: HE'S CHASED IT A MILE! NOWHERE NEAR IT!
grog: OUT OF HIS REACH. THAT'S THE BALL YOU LET GO, NOT THE ONE YOU FISH AT.

bunnings: MADE HIMSELF SOME ROOM. QUITE ENTERPRISING.
lorry: BACKED AWAY AND GIVEN HIMSELF ROOM! CHEEKY!
grog: STEPPING TO LEG TO OPEN UP THE OFF SIDE. THE BOWLER MUST FOLLOW HIM.

bunnings: LOVELY FOOTWORK. RIGHT TO THE PITCH OF IT.
lorry: WHAT FEET! HE WAS THERE AND WAITING FOR IT!
grog: THAT'S THE FOOTWORK. GET TO THE LENGTH AND THE SHOT IS EASY.

bunnings: DOWN THE PITCH, AND IT WORKED. THIS TIME.
lorry: HE'S DANCED DOWN AND HIT IT! WHAT FOOTWORK!
grog: GOT TO THE PITCH OF IT. THE SPINNER HAS TO SEE THAT COMING AND DRAG IT BACK.

bunnings: ALL THAT EFFORT TO REACH IT, AND THEN A BLOCK.
lorry: CAME DOWN THE PITCH AND KEPT IT OUT! SHOWED HIS INTENT!
grog: SMOTHERED ON THE CHARGE. AT LEAST HE'S MADE THE BOWLER THINK ABOUT HIS LENGTH.

bunnings: A LONG WAY FROM HOME, AND NOTHING TO SHOW FOR IT.
lorry: HE'S DOWN THE PITCH AND MISSED IT! HE'S A LUCKY MAN!
grog: BEATEN ON THE CHARGE. FLIGHT AND DIP DID THAT. HE'S LUCKY TO BE IN.

bunnings: AN EDGE, AND NOBODY THERE. FORTUNE FAVOURS THE FORTUNATE.
lorry: EDGED! AND IT'S FALLEN SAFE! HE'S GOT AWAY WITH ONE!
grog: THAT EDGE HAD NOWHERE TO GO. YOU'D WANT A FIELDER THERE.

bunnings: THE SCORER WON'T ASK HOW THEY CAME.
lorry: OFF THE EDGE AND THEY'LL TAKE THE RUNS! NOT PRETTY!
grog: EDGED FOR RUNS. THE BOWLER HAS DONE THE WORK; THE FIELD HASN'T.

bunnings: WELL LEFT. HE KNOWS WHERE HIS OFF STUMP IS.
lorry: LEFT IT! LOVELY JUDGEMENT!

lorry.text: THAT'S TEST MATCH BATTING! KNOW YOUR OFF STUMP!

grog: A DISCIPLINED LEAVE. THE BOWLER HAS TO MAKE HIM PLAY.

grog.text: A LEAVE IN A T20 IS A DOT FOR THE BOWLER. HE'LL TAKE IT.

bunnings: LEFT ON LENGTH. HE TRUSTS THE BOUNCE.
lorry: LET IT GO OVER THE STUMPS! CONFIDENT!
grog: LEAVING ON LENGTH TELLS ME HE'S READ THE PITCH.

bunnings: SOLID. NOTHING TO SEE, WHICH IS RATHER THE POINT.

bunnings.text: THE DEAD BAT. A TEST MATCH STAPLE.

lorry: BLOCKED! RIGHT IN THE MIDDLE OF THE BAT!

lorry.text: DEFENDED! THE CROWD WANT A BIT MORE THAN THAT!

grog: SOFT HANDS, BAT CLOSE TO THE PAD. GOOD TECHNIQUE.

bunnings: GONE. INTO THE CROWD.
lorry: THAT'S HUGE! THAT'S NEARLY OUT OF THE GROUND!
grog: CLEAN HITTING. HE'S STILL, HE'S BALANCED, AND THE HEAD'S DOWN.

bunnings: HE DIDN'T PICK THAT ONE. FEW WOULD HAVE.
lorry: HE HASN'T READ IT! IT'S GONE THE OTHER WAY!
grog: HE'S MISSED THE CHANGE IN THE HAND. WATCH THE WRIST, NOT THE PITCH.

bunnings: BEATEN. A LOVELY DELIVERY.
PAST THE OUTSIDE EDGE. HE'LL FEEL THAT ONE.
lorry: BEATEN! WHAT A BALL! THAT'S A BEAUTY!
OH! HOW DID THAT MISS THE EDGE?!
grog: THAT'S THE CHANNEL. KEEP HITTING IT AND THE EDGE WILL COME.

grog.text: ON A LENGTH, MOVING AWAY. THAT'S TEST MATCH BOWLING.

bunnings: THE BOUNCER, AND IT'S BEEN HOOKED. HE ASKED FOR THAT.
lorry: HOOKED! HE'S TAKEN ON THE SHORT BALL AND WON!
grog: IF YOU BOWL SHORT TO HIM, YOU NEED TWO MEN OUT THERE.

bunnings: UP OFF THE TOP EDGE. NOT ENTIRELY CONVINCING.
lorry: TOP EDGE! IT'S GONE UP, BUT IT'S LANDED SAFE!
grog: THE BOUNCER'S DONE ITS JOB. HE'S GOT HIM HOOKING.

bunnings: FENDED OFF. NOT THE MOST GRACEFUL OF MOMENTS.
lorry: HE'S GOT THE BAT UP JUST IN TIME!
grog: THAT'S THE SHORT BALL DOING ITS JOB. NOW PITCH ONE UP.

bunnings: UNDER IT. A SENSIBLE DECISION.
lorry: HE'S DUCKED! THAT WHISTLED PAST HIS NOSE!
grog: WELL LEFT, UNDER IT. THAT'S ONE OF THE BOWLER'S TWO GONE.

bunnings: A YORKER, DUG OUT FOR RUNS. RESOURCEFUL.
lorry: HE'S GOT HIS BAT DOWN ON THE YORKER AND SQUEEZED IT AWAY!
grog: A FRACTION OFF THE YORKER LENGTH AND HE'S GOT UNDER IT.

bunnings: DUG OUT. AT SOME RISK TO HIS TOES.
lorry: JAMMED OUT! JUST IN TIME!
grog: RIGHT IN THE BLOCKHOLE. NOTHING TO HIT.

grog.text: THAT'S THE BALL AT THE DEATH. LAND IT THERE SIX TIMES AND YOU WIN.

bunnings: UNDER THE BAT. IT VERY NEARLY HIT THEM.
lorry: MISSED THE YORKER! THE STUMPS SURVIVE SOMEHOW!
grog: THE BAT CAME DOWN TOO LATE. THAT'S THE PERFECT YORKER.

bunnings: THE SLOWER ONE. HE WAS RATHER EARLY FOR IT.
lorry: THE SLOWER BALL! HE'S BEEN COMPLETELY FOXED!
grog: SAME ACTION, LESS PACE. HE NEVER SAW IT COMING.

bunnings: HE SAW THE SLOWER BALL. AND WAITED FOR IT.
lorry: HE'S PICKED THE SLOWER ONE! WAITED AND PUT IT AWAY!
grog: THE SLOWER BALL WORKS ONCE AN OVER. TWICE, AND THEY'RE WAITING.

bunnings: A FULL TOSS. HE'LL NOT BE BOASTING ABOUT THAT ONE.
lorry: A FULL TOSS! AND IT'S BEEN DESPATCHED!
grog: A GIFT. YOU CAN'T BOWL THOSE AT THIS LEVEL.

bunnings: A LONG HOP, DULY PUNISHED.
lorry: DRAGGED DOWN AND BELTED! HE'LL WANT THAT ONE BACK!
grog: TOO SHORT. A SPINNER CAN'T DROP SHORT TO A BATTER LIKE THIS.

bunnings: A WIDE. GENEROSITY OF A SORT.
lorry: THAT'S MILES WIDE! THE KEEPER HAD TO DIVE!
grog: A WIDE COSTS YOU MORE THAN THE RUN. IT'S ANOTHER BALL TOO.

bunnings: DOWN THE LEG SIDE. A WASTED BALL.
lorry: DRIFTING DOWN LEG! FREE RUNS!
grog: THE LINE HAS GONE. HE'S FALLING AWAY IN HIS ACTION.

bunnings: {b} IS UNDERWAY. WELL, HE'S FACED ONE.
lorry: FIRST BALL SEEN OFF! {b} CAN BREATHE!
grog: THE FIRST BALL IS ALWAYS THE HARDEST. HE'LL WANT TO GET OFF STRIKE SOON.

bunnings: {b} IS OFF THE MARK. {n} BALLS IN THE MAKING.
lorry: HE'S OFF THE MARK! AFTER {n} BALLS! THE RELIEF!
grog: {n} BALLS TO GET OFF THE MARK. NOW HE CAN START TO BAT.

bunnings: {b} HAS {r} FROM {n} BALLS. IN SOMETHING OF A HURRY.
lorry: {r} OFF {n}! {b} IS ON FIRE!
grog: {r} FROM {n} BALLS. THE CAPTAIN HAS TO FIND SOMETHING DIFFERENT FOR {b}.

bunnings: {r} FROM {n} BALLS. A STUDY IN PATIENCE.
lorry: {n} BALLS FOR {r}! HE'S DUG IN LIKE A TICK!
grog: {r} FROM {n}. THAT'S NOT SLOW, THAT'S A PLAN: WEAR THE BOWLERS DOWN.

bunnings: {w} HAS {figures}. A TIDY DAY'S WORK.
lorry: {w} IS ON TOP! {figures} AND HE'S NOT FINISHED!
grog: {figures} FOR {w}. HE'S BOWLED TO HIS FIELD ALL SPELL.

bunnings: A DIVE TO MAKE IT. THE LAUNDRY WILL HAVE WORK TONIGHT.
lorry: HE'S DIVED! HE'S IN! WHAT A FINISH TO THE RUN!
grog: THE DIVE GOT HIM IN, BUT HE'S DOWN NOW. NO TURNING FOR ANOTHER IN A HURRY.

bunnings: YES, NO, SORRY. THE OLDEST CONVERSATION IN CRICKET.
lorry: SENT BACK! THAT WAS NEARLY A MIX-UP!
grog: CALLING. ONE OF THEM HAS TO TAKE CHARGE OF IT.

bunnings: THREE. THEY'LL BE GLAD OF A SIT DOWN.
lorry: THEY'VE RUN THREE! LOOK AT THEM GO!
grog: GOOD RUNNING TURNS ONES INTO TWOS AND TWOS INTO THREES.

bunnings: THE FIELD HAS MOVED. INTERESTING.
lorry: A CHANGE IN THE FIELD! WHAT'S HE UP TO?
grog: A MAN HAS MOVED. THERE'S A PLAN HERE.

bunnings: {n} BOUNCERS ALREADY THIS OVER.
lorry: {n} BOUNCERS! WILL HE GO AGAIN?
grog: AFTER {n} SHORT ONES, WATCH FOR THE FULL ONE.

bunnings: {types}, AND MORE {types}.
lorry: ALL {types} THIS OVER!
grog: ALL {types}. A CHANGE MUST BE DUE.

bunnings: HE'S HAD SOME TROUBLE {how}.
lorry: SEEN HIM {how}! WATCH THIS!
grog: A KNOWN WEAKNESS: {how}.

bunnings: ALL PITCHED UP THIS OVER.
lorry: FULL, FULL, FULL! HE WANTS THE DRIVE!
grog: FULL EVERY BALL. HE'S HUNTING THE EDGE.

bunnings: BANGING IT IN THIS OVER.
lorry: SHORT AGAIN AND AGAIN!
grog: ALL BACK OF A LENGTH. THAT'S A PLAN.

bunnings: EVERYTHING OUTSIDE OFF THIS OVER.
lorry: OUTSIDE OFF AGAIN! TEASING HIM!
grog: THE CORRIDOR, BALL AFTER BALL.
